open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, balance, and coverage gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan, episode, geometry tag, action motif, horizon, radius, direction, and tentative label before downsampling to balanced release sets.

open_risks.risk: Failure labels may still rely on hidden simulator geometry if decisive-event visibility is poorly implemented.
open_risks.mitigation: Require decisive_event_visible_fraction >= 0.50 or projected_decisive_event_in_start_rgb=true, plus repeat-stable rollout evidence; otherwise reject or mark ambiguous.

open_risks.risk: Conditional answer skew can survive global answer-balance checks.
open_risks.mitigation: Run release audits for label x radius, label x horizon, label x action motif, label x direction, scan, episode, and geometry tag; block release if conditional caps or shortcut baseline ceilings fail.

open_risks.risk: Body Counterfactual can still be solved by radius priors if controls are weak.
open_risks.mitigation: Enforce identical RGB/start/action/camera height, all-radii start validity, monotonicity, true flips, both-safe and neither-safe controls, large-shorter same-bin controls, and radius-only baseline reporting by subtype.

open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, balance, and coverage gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates by scan, episode, geometry tag, action motif, horizon, body profile, direction, and tentative label before downsampling to the release set.

open_risks.risk: Failure visibility projection fields can be implemented inconsistently downstream.
open_risks.mitigation: Treat decisive_event_visible_fraction, projected_decisive_event_in_start_rgb, first_contact_projection_stable, and prompt_render_audit_pass as hard blockers; reject hidden or ambiguous failure cases.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk hazard labels are invalid if support_loss or navmesh_support_violation is unavailable split-wide.
open_risks.mitigation: Use the fixed three-way hazard option set unless support fields are serialized and audited for the whole release split.

open_risks.risk: Conditional balance slices may be sparse after downsampling.
open_risks.mitigation: Require audit tables with cell counts; if a conditional slice is too sparse, oversample or mark that slice as unsupported rather than claiming shortcut resistance.

open_risks.risk: Strict visibility and balance gates may lower accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan, episode, geometry tag, body radius, horizon, action motif, direction, and tentative label before downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Open Chinese explanations can still confuse primary scoring if models omit the requested label.
open_risks.mitigation: Score only the first canonical label or registered release-level alias; mark missing, multiple, or contradictory leading labels invalid for primary scoring.

open_risks.risk: Hazard support-risk labels are only valid if backend support fields are available split-wide.
open_risks.mitigation: Use a release-level hazard_option_set_id: four-way only with audited support fields, otherwise fixed three-way without 地面支撑不足.

open_risks.risk: Hidden-geometry failures may be accepted if decisive collision/drop/support evidence is not visible in the starting RGB.
open_risks.mitigation: Add deterministic failure gates using decisive_event_visible_fraction, projected_decisive_event_in_start_rgb, and first_contact_projection_stable; reject hidden failures as ambiguous.

open_risks.risk: Global answer balance can pass while radius-only, action-only, direction-only, or horizon-only priors remain strong within strata.
open_risks.mitigation: Require conditional label-share caps by radius, horizon, action motif, and direction, plus release-time blind/radius/action/horizon baseline audits.

open_risks.risk: Hazard prompts can leak backend capability or become unscorable if support-risk options vary by case.
open_risks.mitigation: Choose hazard_option_set_id once per release split based on audited support fields; render a fixed three-way or four-way option set for all cases in that split.

open_risks.risk: Body counterfactual prompts may confuse the tested body variable if only a standard body-width horizon is shown.
open_risks.mitigation: Render both compared widths and both approximate horizons in each body's own body-width units.

open_risks.risk: Unconstrained action_phrase rendering can accidentally include answer-leaking scene or outcome adjectives.
open_risks.mitigation: Use a closed grammar over egocentric action primitives and forbid semantic nouns or outcome adjectives in rendered prompts.

open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, balance, stability, and coverage gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates by scan, episode, geometry tag, action motif, horizon, radius, direction, and tentative label before downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Safe or failure labels may be invalid if visibility fields are implemented loosely.
open_risks.mitigation: Treat safe_path_visible_fraction, floor_support_visible_fraction, terminal_free_space_margin_m, decisive_event_visible_fraction, and prompt_render_audit_pass as hard release blockers.

open_risks.risk: Body Counterfactual can still be solved by priors if controls are underrepresented.
open_risks.mitigation: Enforce true flips, both-safe controls, neither-safe controls, large-shorter same-label controls, monotonicity checks, and radius-only subtype audits.

open_risks.risk: Hazard labels can become unscorable if support-risk fields are unavailable.
open_risks.mitigation: Select hazard_option_set_id once per release split; use the four-way support-risk option only when support fields are serialized and audited split-wide.

critique_items.issue: Failure-label visibility is not deterministic enough. The draft says failure evidence must be visible or locally inferable, but does not define a numeric threshold comparable to safe-label visibility gates.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Require decisive_event_visible_fraction >= 0.50 or projected_decisive_event_in_start_rgb=true with first_contact_projection_stable=true for collision/stopped failures; require visible floor/support/drop evidence for drop/support failures; otherwise reject or mark ambiguous.

critique_items.issue: Shortcut audits for radius-only, action-only, horizon-only, and direction priors are named but not thresholded outside Body Counterfactual.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add conditional max-label-share caps by radius, horizon, action motif, and direction; for release, also require blind/radius-only/action-only/horizon-only baselines to stay below declared ceilings.

critique_items.issue: The Local Hazard template can show 地面支撑不足 even when support fields are unavailable, while the scoring rule conditionally removes it.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Define hazard_option_set_id at release-split level: four-way only with audited support_loss/navmesh_support_violation fields, otherwise fixed three-way without 地面支撑不足.

critique_items.issue: Body Counterfactual uses a standard-width horizon instead of per-body body-width horizons.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Render small_width_m, large_width_m, small_horizon_body_widths, and large_horizon_body_widths; compute them from serialized intended_distance_m and each radius.

critique_items.issue: action_phrase generation is unconstrained and could leak answers through scene adjectives or semantic nouns.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Use a closed action grammar limited to direct forward N steps, turn left/right K degrees then forward N steps, and serialized primitive sequences; reject prompts containing scene semantics or outcome adjectives.
